subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace question mark in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152b798de4016f5ae1e27b5f8e34a017bb33a8b0110b232f504df7f1173872f8.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Both the images kite and square are changing their position by moving in clockwise direction.

2) In first figure, the image of kite is big and in next figure the image of kite is small. So, the image of kite is big at odd positions and small at even positions.

Similarly, if we observe, we find that the image of square is small at odd positions and big at even positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59b0015491e74982b0b44c68233490bd7fcbaf9fc2551e54f18f35486f38836f.png] 

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.
